head: Gemini Gems go read-only on 17 November, replaced by Skills
dek: Google is retiring Gems, Gemini's custom assistants. They turn read-only on 17 November and disappear on 17 December; Google converts existing Gems into Skills automatically.
details: Skills work inside any chat: type @ and pick one, or Gemini uses it by itself when your request fits. They're free in regular chats and found under Customize > Skills. Skills have a 100 MB file limit, and the largest files of a bigger Gem are dropped first. Sharing skills and adding Google Drive files are still a few weeks away; Workspace and school accounts reportedly have until 2027.
where: Gemini personal accounts; Gems read-only from 17 November 2026
means: If you rely on a Gem, it will become a Skill you call inside your chats; check it still works the way you want.
todo: Open Customize > Skills before 17 November and check your converted Gems. If a Gem uses big files, keep copies of them.
